c1-07-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Immediately
c1-07-01.scenario: A colleague asks what has to happen with a decision that has just been made.
c1-07-01.prompt: Say that the decision must be executed at once.
c1-07-01.english: The decision is to be executed immediately.
c1-07-01.canDo: I can use the participle in *-andó/-endő* as a legal command (*végrehajtandó*, *figyelembe veendő*).

c1-07-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Has to Prove It
c1-07-02.scenario: A friend asks who has to prove that the rules were followed.
c1-07-02.target: A bizonyítás kötelezettsége a kérelmezőt terheli.
c1-07-02.english: The duty of proof lies on the applicant.
c1-07-02.canDo: I can say who bears a duty with *terheli a kötelezettség*.

c1-07-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Valid Contract
c1-07-03.scenario: A friend asks whether a contract is valid.
c1-07-03.prompt: Say that it is valid, state the condition and name an exception.
c1-07-03.target: A szerződés érvényes, feltéve, hogy a felek aláírták, kivéve, ha a törvény mást ír elő.
c1-07-03.english: The contract is valid, provided that the parties signed it, unless the law prescribes otherwise.
c1-07-03.canDo: I can state a condition with *feltéve, hogy* and an exception with *kivéve, ha*.

c1-07-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Whose Job Is It
c1-07-04.scenario: A friend asks which office decides on a complaint.
c1-07-04.target: A panasz elbírálása a felügyeleti szerv hatáskörébe tartozik.
c1-07-04.english: Deciding on the complaint falls within the jurisdiction of the supervisory body.
c1-07-04.canDo: I can say whose task something is with *hatáskörébe tartozik*.

c1-07-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Text Says About Power
c1-07-05.scenario: You have read a short text about József Eötvös, and a friend asks what it says about state power.
c1-07-05.prompt: Tell your friend what the text says about the limits of state power.
cues: Say where the limits come from
c1-07-05.target: A szöveg szerint a szabadság feltétele az államhatalom intézményes korlátja.
c1-07-05.english: According to the text, the guarantee of liberty is the institutional limit on state power.
c1-07-05.canDo: I can say what the text about Eötvös says about state power and liberty.

c1-07-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Do It, Unless
c1-07-consolidation.scenario: A friend asks you to explain a rule about a decision.
c1-07-consolidation.prompt: Say that the decision must be executed, with one exception.
c1-07-consolidation.target: A határozat azonnal végrehajtandó, kivéve, ha a hatóság mást ír elő.
c1-07-consolidation.english: The decision is to be executed at once, unless the authority prescribes otherwise.
c1-07-consolidation.canDo: I can use the participle in *-andó/-endő* as a legal command.
